# Ingots

> Statically typed composition of Python applications from reusable addons,
> customizable at any depth. Being rewritten from scratch: the package is
> empty so far; the design is decided in the ecosystem's ADRs.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): what Ingots is, the development commands
- [Contributing](docs/contributing.md): make targets, tests on the built wheel, changelog fragments
- [Changelog fragments](changelog.d/README.md): the mandatory news fragment per change

## Design

- [ADR 0004](https://github.com/ak-ingots/ingots-libs/blob/main/docs/adr/0004-static-composition-with-typed-slots.md): static composition with typed slots
- [ADR 0005](https://github.com/ak-ingots/ingots-libs/blob/main/docs/adr/0005-addons-ship-contract-tests.md): addons ship contract tests
- [ADR 0006](https://github.com/ak-ingots/ingots-libs/blob/main/docs/adr/0006-design-principles.md): design principles
- [Composition concepts](https://github.com/ak-ingots/ingots-libs/blob/main/docs/design/extension-composition/README.md): the prototypes behind ADR 0004

## Optional

- [Makefile](Makefile): how every check actually runs
